title: Reserve-balanced affine local moment
description: Reallocates intermediate LOW and extracted-error reserves to enlarge the affine local-moment defect allowance to 1/250 while retaining the amplifier, volume cap, and final analytic savings. Regenerates the endpoint and transport arithmetic for the canonical all-Dirichlet statement. Builds on Kari Roegnvaldsson's affine-capacity proof, nielstron's local 22/5 moment, Zhongpai Gao's local-moment work, Hailey Collet's Cycle25 framework, Akash Levy's weighted numerator, and OpenAI/math. Prepared with AI assistance.
